faqs.q: What is the difference between Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing?
faqs.a: A vulnerability assessment scans and lists potential vulnerabilities across your network or app. Penetration testing goes a step further by actively attempting to exploit those vulnerabilities to measure their real-world damage and reach.

faqs.q: Will VAPT cause downtime in our production environment?
faqs.a: No. Our testing is carefully controlled, scheduled in advance, and conducted according to strict rules of engagement to ensure business continuity without system interruption.

faqs.q: How often should an organization undergo VAPT?
faqs.a: Industry standards and compliance mandates recommend undergoing VAPT at least annually, or following any major architecture change, system upgrade, or feature rollout.
